scope: Closed heated/cooled positive-inertance pipe loops with a small linear gravity-density anomaly and explicitly compensated buoyancy work
mass_density: Constant rho_ref; gravity_density diagnostic does not change stored mass, inertia or thermal capacity
energy_closure: Signed buoyancy work transferred from cp-temperature proxy inventories to kinetic energy; equal endpoint split
theory_motivation: Maruyama2014 section2 equations19-24; not a full implementation of its temperature/thermodynamic equation25
domain: density anomaly<=5%, relative temperature anomaly<=10%, g*beta*height/cp<=0.01; declared engineering limits, not water applicability standards
stationary_scope: Three seeded nontrivial stationary branches; no uniqueness or transient asymptotic-convergence claim
